subject: Animation
title: Beauty and the Beast Makes Oscar History
description: A 60-second lesson on Beauty and the Beast Makes Oscar History.

hook.text: In 1991, Beauty and the Beast became the first animated film nominated for Best Picture at the Oscars.

buildup.text: Howard Ashman wrote the lyrics while terminally ill. He died before the film was released.

discovery.text: The ballroom scene used CGI backgrounds with hand-drawn characters, a stunning achievement.

twist.text: The nomination shocked Hollywood. Nobody had considered animation worthy of the top prize before.

climax.text: Beauty and the Beast expanded what critics and audiences believed animation could achieve.

punchline.text: A cartoon fairy tale competed with Hollywood's finest.

quiz.question: What Oscar milestone did Beauty and the Beast achieve?
options: It became the first animated film nominated for Best Picture
